svg.aria-label: The same error budget spent two ways. A fast burn empties it in hours and both the short and long alert windows agree, so it pages. A slow trickle empties it over a week: the short window stays quiet and the long window notices, so it becomes a ticket rather than a page. A thirty-second blip moves neither.
svg.text: THE SAME BUDGET, SPENT THREE WAYS · 43 MINUTES PER MONTH AT 99.9%
